```artifact
Feature: Admin and User Functionalities

  @VIRTUA-2.3-5
  Scenario Outline: Admin can edit labs/pharmacy details
    Given the admin is logged in
    When the admin updates the <field> to <value>
    Then the <field> should be updated to <value>
    Examples:
      | field        | value          |
      | lab name     | New Lab Name   |
      | pharmacy name| New Pharmacy   |
      | lab name     |                | # Edge case: empty value
      | pharmacy name|                | # Edge case: empty value

  @VIRTUA-2.3-5
  Scenario Outline: Admin can delete labs/pharmacy details
    Given the admin is logged in
    When the admin deletes the <entity>
    Then the <entity> should no longer exist
    Examples:
      | entity       |
      | lab          |
      | pharmacy     |

  @VIRTUA-2.3-6
  Scenario Outline: Patient can register
    Given the patient is on the registration page
    When the patient enters the following details:
      | field        | value          |
      | name         | <name>         |
      | email        | <email>        |
      | password     | <password>     |
    And the patient submits the registration form
    Then the patient should be registered successfully
    Examples:
      | name         | email                  | password     |
      | John Doe     | john.doe@example.com   | Password123  |
      | Jane Smith   | jane.smith@example.com | Password456  |
      |              | jane.smith@example.com | Password456  | # Edge case: empty name
      | Jane Smith   |                        | Password456  | # Edge case: empty email
      | Jane Smith   | jane.smith@example.com |              | # Edge case: empty password

  @VIRTUA-2.3-7
  Scenario Outline: Patient can update profile
    Given the patient is logged in
    When the patient updates the <field> to <value>
    Then the <field> should be updated to <value>
    Examples:
      | field        | value          |
      | name         | New Name       |
      | email        | new.email@example.com |
      | name         |                | # Edge case: empty value
      | email        |                | # Edge case: empty value

  @VIRTUA-2.3-8
  Scenario Outline: Patient can make appointments and submit online consultation requests
    Given the patient is logged in
    When the patient makes an appointment with <doctor> on <date>
    And the patient submits a consultation request with the following details:
      | field        | value          |
      | symptoms     | <symptoms>     |
      | notes        | <notes>        |
    Then the appointment should be scheduled with <doctor> on <date>
    And the consultation request should be submitted successfully
    Examples:
      | doctor       | date           | symptoms         | notes          |
      | Dr. Smith    | 2023-12-15     | Fever            | None           |
      | Dr. Johnson  | 2023-12-16     | Headache         | Severe         |
      | Dr. Smith    | 2023-12-15     |                  | None           | # Edge case: empty symptoms
      | Dr. Johnson  | 2023-12-16     | Headache         |                | # Edge case: empty notes

  @VIRTUA-2.3-9
  Scenario Outline: Patient can view and generate prescription reports and invoices
    Given the patient is logged in
    When the patient views the prescription report for <appointment>
    And the patient generates an invoice for <appointment>
    Then the prescription report for <appointment> should be displayed
    And the invoice for <appointment> should be generated
    Examples:
      | appointment  |
      | 2023-12-15   |
      | 2023-12-16   |

  @VIRTUA-2.3-10
  Scenario Outline: Doctor can provide consultation
    Given the doctor is logged in
    When the doctor provides consultation for <patient> on <date>
    And the doctor enters the following details:
      | field        | value          |
      | diagnosis    | <diagnosis>    |
      | notes        | <notes>        |
    Then the consultation for <patient> on <date> should be recorded
    Examples:
      | patient      | date           | diagnosis        | notes          |
      | John Doe     | 2023-12-15     | Cold             | Take rest      |
      | Jane Smith   | 2023-12-16     | Flu              | Drink fluids   |
      | John Doe     | 2023-12-15     |                  | Take rest      | # Edge case: empty diagnosis
      | Jane Smith   | 2023-12-16     | Flu              |                | # Edge case: empty notes

  @VIRTUA-2.3-11
  Scenario Outline: Doctor can prescribe medicine
    Given the doctor is logged in
    When the doctor prescribes <medicine> to <patient> on <date>
    And the doctor enters the following details:
      | field        | value          |
      | dosage       | <dosage>       |
      | duration     | <duration>     |
    Then the prescription for <medicine> to <patient> on <date> should be recorded
    Examples:
      | medicine     | patient        | date           | dosage         | duration     |
      | Paracetamol  | John Doe       | 2023-12-15     | 500mg          | 7 days       |
      | Ibuprofen    | Jane Smith     | 2023-12-16     | 200mg          | 10 days      |
      | Paracetamol  | John Doe       | 2023-12-15     |                | 7 days       | # Edge case: empty dosage
      | Ibuprofen    | Jane Smith     | 2023-12-16     | 200mg          |              | # Edge case: empty duration

  @VIRTUA-2.3-12
  Scenario Outline: Doctor can prescribe lab tests
    Given the doctor is logged in
    When the doctor prescribes <test> to <patient> on <date>
    Then the lab test <test> for <patient> on <date> should be recorded
    Examples:
      | test         | patient        | date           |
      | Blood Test   | John Doe       | 2023-12-15     |
      | Urine Test   | Jane Smith     | 2023-12-16     |
      | Blood Test   | John Doe       |                | # Edge case: empty date
      | Urine Test   |                | 2023-12-16     | # Edge case: empty patient
```
